About

About NASHA.

NASHA is food and beer designed together to captivate you, made in plain sight and shared at a long table.

It is a project of Ritesh Mamidi, who is building toward an Indo-Mex brewery and kitchen in Austin, Texas. Today it is a body of design and a plan, not a business that serves anyone.

The name

The founder chose the name NASHA. Legal clearance of the name has not been completed, and nothing here claims trademark ownership, registration, availability, or ownership of any domain or social handle. If a professional review finds a problem, the name returns to the founder for a decision.

Nasha means intoxication or addiction in Hindi and Urdu. We chose it for the feeling of being captivated by food and beer. We commit to never romanticising addiction, alcoholism or dangerous drinking, and to asking cultural advisors to review the name and our language before launch.

How we handle rights

Every file on this site is listed in a rights register: what it is, who made it, how, and under what licence. Illustrations are original vector drawings made for this project. Fonts are Inter and Instrument Serif, both under the SIL Open Font License. We use no stock photos, no third-party scripts and no trackers. No photographs are shown, because we do not yet have rights-clean ones of a place that does not exist.

Evidence and honesty

Design is not proof. This site shows what we have designed. It does not show that anyone wants it, that it can be brewed or cooked well, or that it can be built. Those are tests still to come, and Labs will report them.

Contact

There is no public contact address or mailing list yet. We will add one when it is real.

NASHA is a future Indo-Mex brewery and kitchen in Austin, Texas, in development.

The name was chosen by the founder. Legal clearance of the name is pending. Nothing here claims trademark ownership. There is no brewery, restaurant or truck open, and nothing is for sale.

In Hindi and Urdu, nasha means intoxication or addiction. We chose it for the feeling of being captivated by food and beer. We take that meaning seriously and will never present excess or addiction as something to admire. Cultural advisors will review the name and our language before launch.

Menu items are designs for testing, not served food. Heat levels and vegetarian labels describe how a dish is designed, not a certified allergen or dietary statement. Ask before you eat if you have an allergy. If you drink, drink responsibly. Alcohol is for adults of legal drinking age.
